assertions.name: correspondence_all_five_green
assertions.expected: all five correspondence checks pass against the real merged buffers

assertions.name: merged_buffers_non_empty
assertions.expected: the arena mounted real, non-empty merged geometry (one mesh per material)

assertions.name: shot_hook_installed
assertions.expected: the level installed window.__SHOT__ for the evidence tool

assertions.name: static_world_published
assertions.expected: the shipping StaticWorld is published and non-empty

assertions.name: box_count_detail_present
assertions.expected: box-count correspondence detail present and green

assertions.name: dispose_removes_arena_root
assertions.expected: dispose removed the arena root group from the scene

assertions.name: dispose_cleans_globals
assertions.expected: dispose deleted the window.__SHOT__ and window.__ARENA_CHECK__ hooks

assertions.name: dispose_releases_geometry
assertions.expected: GPU geometry handles dropped after dispose (merged buffers freed)

assertions.name: rebuild_correspondence_green
assertions.expected: a fresh build on a new scene passes correspondence again (no leaked state)

assertions.name: rebuild_matches_first_build
assertions.expected: the rebuilt merged geometry is identical to the first build (deterministic)

assertions.name: unsafe_default_path_throws
assertions.expected: raw new ArenaLevel(def, world) with DEFAULT options throws building container dressing on the relay's empty container selection (the integration footgun) — and not from a correspondence failure

assertions.name: factory_default_path_survives
assertions.expected: createRelayLevel() builds + passes correspondence on the same default-shaped path that crashes raw ArenaLevel, and builds NO container-dressing layer

assertions.name: factory_explicit_undefined_resolves_off
assertions.expected: createRelayLevel({ containerDressing: undefined }) still resolves to OFF via `?? false`, so the explicit-undefined path never throws either
